newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan's deputy foreign minister resigns.
newsitem.headline: Jordan's deputy foreign minister resigns.

text.p: Jordan's Minister of State for Foreign Affairs Khaled Madadha has submitted his resignation to Prime Minister Abdul-Karim al-Kabariti, a government official said on Tuesday.
The official did not say if Madadha's resignation had been accepted by Kabariti, who is also Jordan's foreign minister.
Madadha was a career diplomat in Europe and Japan before being appointed director of the prime minister's office and then minister of state for foreign affairs.
